summary: Friends for any game: the friends list, requests, suggestions and the notification inbox, with a player card and add-by-ID in popups.
description: A ready friends screen (Unity Runtime/UI/Friends) for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit and client.social. Tabs: friends, requests (incoming with accept / decline, and the ones you sent), suggestions (players active in this game lately) and news — the notification inbox (attacks, raids, new friends, sales, follows, likes, comments), opened as seen. The player's own ID sits on top with a copy button. Everything detailed is a popup: adding a friend by ID, the player card (level, power; message — opens the chat feature when chat is installed; remove friend; block) and the confirmations. When the title takes friends from idosgames.com only, requests, suggestions and 'Add' disappear and platform friends cannot be removed in the game. Registers the 'friends' feature; its badge counts requests waiting and unread news. No title settings needed.
provides: player card with message, remove and block
